diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says 1, datasheet reading says P1
diffs.evidence: Naming-only difference for the same physical tab. The Spectra Symbol FS-L-0055-253-ST datasheet (Rev A2) gives no pin names at all: its Dimensional Diagram shows a plain two-terminal strip and the order code lists only 'ST = Solder Tab'. The sensor is a non-polarised resistor (Flat Resistance 25K Ohms, Bend Resistance Range 45K to 125K Ohms), so the two tabs are interchangeable. The model's '1' and the second reading's 'P1' are both arbitrary labels for the first of two equivalent unlabelled tabs; the wiring (tab to 3.3 V) is unaffected.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says 2, datasheet reading says P2
diffs.evidence: Naming-only difference for the same physical tab. The datasheet labels neither solder tab ('Connectors: ST = Solder Tab', no pinout or silkscreen); the part is a non-polarised two-terminal resistor (25K Ohms flat, 45K-125K Ohms bent), so '2' and 'P2' both denote the second, interchangeable tab. The model's divider wiring (tab to ADC with 47 kOhm to GND) is correct either way.
